description: Validate an order against risk limits and estimate fill price and fees. With dry_run: true nothing else happens. Otherwise returns typed_data to sign and a prepared_id for submit_signed_order (valid 120 s). Use when you sign transactions yourself.

builder_approval.description: Signed builder-fee approval; needed once before the first real order

dry_run.description: true: only validate and estimate costs

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation so it is not executed twice.

market.description: Market symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL (see get_markets)

market_type.description: perp (default) or spot; spot only for markets get_markets lists as spot

notional_usd.description: Order value in USD. Give this or size.

size.description: Base-asset size. Give this or notional_usd.

slippage_bps.description: Market orders: max slippage vs mid in basis points (default 50)

stop_loss.description: Market orders on perps: reduce-only stop-loss that closes this position when the mark price crosses trigger_price

take_profit.description: Market orders on perps: reduce-only take-profit that closes this position when the mark price crosses trigger_price

name: prepare_order
title: Prepare order
